name: Antigravity CLI
description: Installs Google's Antigravity CLI (agy) and mounts local config files from the host.

instructionFilePath.description: Path to the central instruction file, relative to the workspace root. Default is empty (disabled). Set to a path (e.g. 'docs/agents/AGENTS.md') to enable instruction symlinking.

rulesPath.description: Path to the rules directory, relative to the workspace root. Default is empty (disabled). Set to a path (e.g. 'docs/agents/rules') to link it to .agents/rules.

skillsPath.description: Path to the modular skills directory, relative to the workspace root. Default is empty (disabled). Set to a path (e.g. 'docs/agents/skills') to enable skills mapping.
